instructions: Read the original source turns and relevant current-product context BEFORE reading generated requirements. Source syntax is checked here; source content and authorship are not verified by this preview.

Reconstruct the intended experience independently. Compare it with the brief, concrete scenarios and requirements; report omissions, contradictions, unsupported additions and material ambiguous choices with exact references.
Keep assumptions distinct from owner requests. Investigate routine technical choices yourself; ask only material product questions with a recommended answer.
Use the existing independent review route. These structural diagnostics do not prove semantic completeness or owner approval; full verification remains unchanged.

productShaping.next: Shape the product before requirements/tasks: record audience, current problem, intended outcome, non-goals and original source refs. Investigate existing behavior and recommend defaults; ask only about consequential product choices, never engineering methodology. Map scenarios to R-N requirements and their existing Design BAR-to-work map. Use plans:audit phase:shaping for advisory gaps and the original-intent reviewer brief; save edits with plans:set-content.
